description: An aluminium L-bracket as a FEM flexible body (ModalBody3D, Craig-Bampton 4 + 6 modes) carrying a 0.5 kg payload: on an indexing turntable, and clamped for a ring-down whose frequencies match the full finite element model with the payload attached.

checks.note: the table is back at 0 after the two index moves

the payload rings near the first clamped bracket mode after the move (the servo spring lowers it slightly); full finite element model (39348 dofs) clamped at A with the payload at B: 18.5719 / 30.8750 Hz; reduced model 18.5719 / 30.8750 Hz
the index moves keep the bracket below half the 6082-T6 yield strength (250 MPa)
full finite element model (39348 dofs) clamped at A with the payload at B: 18.5719 / 30.8750 Hz; reduced model 18.5719 / 30.8750 Hz
full finite element model (39348 dofs) clamped at A with the payload at B: 18.5719 / 30.8750 Hz; reduced model 18.5719 / 30.8750 Hz

linear modal superposition of the reduced model with the payload rigid at B (design/build.py, no BGSim), first 30 ms: max von Mises 8.204 MPa at upright 30 mm, 4.708 MPa at the root, 21.672 MPa over the stress points; beam theory: F = m w v = 5.83 N at the payload centre, sigma_zz = F (0.175 - 0.03) c / I = 7.93 MPa

the bracket stays below half the 6082-T6 yield strength (250 MPa)
